new-and-changed-responsibilities.text: A new deployment command and identity library, three attaching runners, the gate check, the carried mirror, the tip-anchored retract builder, and the onboarding page, each with its must-not. The flowchart shows identity flowing from command to manifest to runners.

dependency-direction.text: Identity flows from command into manifest and from manifest into every runner, which keep their existing builders. Docs describe the commands without defining identity.

promotion.text: One new library module owned by deployment and the attached runners. No wider extraction and no changes to Lean, validators, workflow, or gates.
